_comment: Single source of truth for RevenueCat entitlement/product identifiers and the progression unlock gates. backend/server.py reads this directly. frontend/src/lib/entitlements.generated.json is a generated copy — run `yarn sync-entitlements` in frontend/ (or just `yarn start`/`yarn build`, which do it automatically) after editing this file. Adding a new rarity tier, product, or renaming the entitlement only ever touches this one file.
